# The Meet Rack: _Come Hungry_

At this year's Dark Odyssey: Surrender, the Meet Rack returns along with the Meet Locker!

Two styles of objectification at the same time on Saturday night.

### Personal Responsibility

[Personal Responsibility](https://meet-rack.com/personal-responsibility.html)

Read This: Important information about boundaries, consent, and assumed risk for participants.

### Going on The Meet Rack

[The Meet Rack](https://meet-rack.com/meet-rack.html)

A chance for people who crave a bit of objectification to fulfill those fantasies. People go "on the Rack" and may be restrained, either naked or with some clothing for the groping pleasure of the crowd. There are explicit rules about what is or is not allowed.

### I will only be Groping the Meet

[Groping the Meet](https://meet-rack.com/groping.html)

The rest of the conference-goers are free to Grope the people on the Rack according to the rules. They may interact with the scenes being offered in the Locker for whatever kind or activity they agree on.

### Going on the Meet Locker

[The Meet Locker](https://meet-rack.com/meet-locker.html)

A chance for more "serious" objectification where you may put yourself in a position to be more fully used, groped, teased, fucked, beaten, played with, etc.

**The key is BYOM = You Bring Your Own Monitor** to be with you for the entire time, to be in charge of you, your consent, your limits, and your safety. With your own monitor you may offer any kind of play you wish (within DO rules)

### "Speed Meeting"

### Aftercare

[Aftercare](https://meet-rack.com/aftercare.html)

Information about aftercare following the event.

The Meet Rack relies on volunteer monitors to help us keep things flowing smoothly and safely. We are trying half-shifts this year. Please consider helping. Getting enough volunteers is one of the hardest part of running the event.

[Volunteer as Monitor](https://meet-rack.com/call-for-monitors.html) [Monitor Guide](https://meet-rack.com/monitor-guide.html)

We also need a setup and teardown crew. It's a fast turnaround between the end of classes and the start of the party, so every extra pair of hands counts — and you still get to enjoy the Rack afterwards. Setup is Saturday evening, 7:00–8:00 PM.

[Volunteer for Setup Crew](https://meet-rack.com/setup-crew.html)

## We're expecting to kick off Saturday night with a lot of great fun! The Meet Rack has changed people's lives, we hope it adds to yours!
